main_text.p: modum & mensuram debi-cler.in duell. pugn.&tam reposcere.

Neque à jure civili, hacte-Concil. Tridenť. sess. 25. superRe-form. c. 19. Bar-bof. in colleƈt. ad concil. Tri-dent.nus allegato recedunt cano-nes, aut antiqui aut novi,con-ciliorum etiam anteriorum, & modernorum decreta, quibus statutum, ut à duellis sub pœ-nâ excommunicationis absti-nendum sit.

Verùm progrediar ad ratio-Zyp.ad tit. de cler. Pugn.in duell.nes, partim ex jure divino, partim aliunde desumptas. 1. Peccant enim qui singulare in-Concil. Biturić. de ann. 1584.eunt certamen in divinum præceptum, in quantum injurias illatas ipsimet ulciscuntur: cum Deus peculiari jure sibi vindictam reservaverit: mihi, inquit, vindicta est, & ego retribuam. Quæ verba à Moise expressa, reperit Apostolus Paulus, non vosmet ipsos ulciscentes carissimi: sed date locum iræ: scriptum est enim: mihi vindicta est, & ego retribuam, dicit dominus.Deuter. 32.v.35.Rom.12. v.19.

page.notes: Printed "1." after "desumptas" is a section mark in the text. The note block at the right margin is read from top to bottom. Some note abbreviations, such as "Tridenť." and "colleƈt.", are doubtful and are not marked with [?]. "Cum" catchword is a partial word at the foot.
